# ===== judge.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# judge.sh — S52 compliance battery for souji-shokunin round 2 (tools/souji-verify.sh).
#
# External, spec-derived verification. Independent of the tool's own --selftest:
# builds its own fixture "mini fleet" under this mktemp dir and reproduces the
# binding fixture cases F1-F10 plus CLI/exit-code, safety-rail and determinism
# checks. Writes only this /tmp scratch dir and the lane file
# tests/results/compliance-52.json. Fixture commits are deterministic
# (fixed dates/content via git plumbing; branch porcelain is never invoked).
set -euo pipefail

J=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
LANE=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin
REAL_TOOL=$LANE/tools/souji-verify.sh
SPEC=$LANE/tools/souji-verify.spec.md
RESULTS_DIR=$LANE/tests/results
OUT_JSON=$RESULTS_DIR/compliance-52.json
KOTODAMA_REAL=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kotodama-shokunin
LOG=$J/logs
CHECKS=$J/checks.tsv
META=$J/meta.env
GT=$J/ground_truth.tsv
CRES=$J/case_results.tsv
CMAP=$J/case_map.tsv
mkdir -p "$LOG"
: > "$CHECKS"; : > "$META"; : > "$GT"; : > "$CRES"; : > "$CMAP"

F=$J/myshokunin-root
VAULT=$J/vault
O=$F/owner-shokunin
K=$F/kotodama-shokunin
F9R=$F/f9repo
W4PATH=$F/wt4
W5REPO=$F/wt5
COPIED_TOOL=$F/souji-shokunin/tools/souji-verify.sh

san() { printf '%s' "$1" | tr '\t\n' '  '; }
rec() { # id sev pass expected observed command
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" "$(san "$4")" "$(san "$5")" "$(san "$6")" >> "$CHECKS"
}
meta() { printf '%s=%s\n' "$1" "$(san "$2")" >> "$META"; }
gt() { printf '%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$(san "$2")" >> "$GT"; }
count() { awk 'END{print NR+0}'; }

RC=0
run() { local o=$1; shift; set +e; "$@" >"$o.out" 2>"$o.err"; RC=$?; set -e; }
runenv() { local o=$1; shift; set +e; env SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$F" "$@" >"$o.out" 2>"$o.err"; RC=$?; set -e; }

cd "$J"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- metadata
meta user "$(id -un)"
meta judged_at_utc "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
meta git_version "$(git --version)"
meta lane_head "$(git -C "$LANE" rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD || echo none)"
meta spec_sha256 "$(sha256sum -- "$SPEC" | awk '{print $1}')"
meta harness_sha256 "$(sha256sum -- "$J/judge.sh" | awk '{print $1}')"
TOOL_SHA=$(sha256sum -- "$REAL_TOOL" | awk '{print $1}')
meta tool_sha256 "$TOOL_SHA"
meta tool_lines "$(wc -l < "$REAL_TOOL" | tr -d ' ')"
meta tool_mode "$(stat -c %a -- "$REAL_TOOL")"
if [ -x "$REAL_TOOL" ]; then meta tool_executable yes; else meta tool_executable no; fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- syntax / mode
run "$LOG/syntax" bash -n "$REAL_TOOL"
if [ "$RC" = 0 ]; then
  rec A_SYNTAX required 1 "bash -n exit 0" "rc=0" "bash -n $REAL_TOOL"
else
  rec A_SYNTAX required 0 "bash -n exit 0" "rc=$RC $(san "$(head -n 2 "$LOG/syntax.err" || true)")" "bash -n $REAL_TOOL"
fi
if [ -x "$REAL_TOOL" ]; then
  rec A_EXECBIT required 1 "executable (spec CLI: tools/souji-verify.sh ...)" "mode=$(stat -c %a -- "$REAL_TOOL")" "test -x $REAL_TOOL"
else
  rec A_EXECBIT required 0 "executable (spec CLI: tools/souji-verify.sh ...)" "mode=$(stat -c %a -- "$REAL_TOOL") input must be chmod +x at integration" "test -x $REAL_TOOL"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- fixtures
export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=s52fx GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=s52fx@fixture.local
export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=s52fx GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=s52fx@fixture.local

fixture_commit() { # repo date msg [parent]
  local repo=$1 date=$2 msg=$3 parent=${4:-} tree sha
  tree=$(git -C "$repo" write-tree)
  if [ -n "$parent" ]; then
    sha=$(GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=$date GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=$date git -C "$repo" commit-tree "$tree" -p "$parent" -m "$msg")
  else
    sha=$(GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=$date GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=$date git -C "$repo" commit-tree "$tree" -m "$msg")
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$sha"
}

rm -rf -- "$F" "$VAULT"
mkdir -p "$F/souji-shokunin/tools" "$F/souji-shokunin/census" \
         "$F/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge" "$F/corpus/knowledge" \
         "$F/envcases" "$F/empty-dir" "$VAULT"
cp -- "$REAL_TOOL" "$COPIED_TOOL"
printf 'artifact\tnote\ns52fx-f8-census-only.log\tcensus mention that must be excluded from reference sweeps (D3)\n' \
  > "$F/souji-shokunin/census/f8-mention.tsv"

# owner-shokunin: F1 pushed / F2 local-only / F6 ledger source / F7,F8,E1 scratch / F4,F5 worktrees
git init -q -- "$O"
git -C "$O" symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/master
mkdir -p "$O/docs" "$O/.scratch"
printf 'pushed file from fixture baseline\n' > "$O/s52fx-f1.txt"
printf 'keep me\n' > "$O/docs/keep.md"
printf 'See .scratch/s52fx-ref-marker.log before removal.\n' > "$O/docs/notes.md"
git -C "$O" add -A
C1=$(fixture_commit "$O" 2026-10-15T09:00:00Z "C1: pushed baseline")
git -C "$O" update-ref refs/heads/master "$C1"
git -C "$O" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/master "$C1"
git -C "$O" symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD refs/remotes/origin/master
git -C "$O" config remote.origin.url "$J/origins/owner.git"
printf 'local only change\n' > "$O/s52fx-f2-local.txt"
git -C "$O" add -A
C2=$(fixture_commit "$O" 2026-10-15T09:10:00Z "C2: local only" "$C1")
git -C "$O" update-ref refs/heads/master "$C2"
printf 'scratch log - safe to delete\n' > "$O/.scratch/s52fx-f7-orphan.log"
printf 'scratch log - safe to delete\n' > "$O/.scratch/s52fx-f8-census-only.log"
printf 'held reference marker scratch\n' > "$O/.scratch/s52fx-ref-marker.log"
printf 'cold storage note\n' > "$O/s52fx-obs-source.txt"
touch -d '3 days ago' "$O/.scratch/s52fx-f7-orphan.log" \
                     "$O/.scratch/s52fx-f8-census-only.log" \
                     "$O/.scratch/s52fx-ref-marker.log"
cp -- "$O/s52fx-obs-source.txt" "$VAULT/s52fx-obs-source.txt"
SHA_SRC=$(sha256sum -- "$O/s52fx-obs-source.txt" | awk '{print $1}')
SHA_VAULT=$(sha256sum -- "$VAULT/s52fx-obs-source.txt" | awk '{print $1}')
for led in "$F/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv" "$F/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"; do
  {
    printf 'source_path\tsource_sha256\tvault_path\tvault_sha256\texported_at\tnote\n'
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t2026-10-15T00:00:00Z\ts52-fixture\n' \
      "$O/s52fx-obs-source.txt" "$SHA_SRC" "$VAULT/s52fx-obs-source.txt" "$SHA_VAULT"
  } > "$led"
done

# F4: detached worktree registration, dir then removed.
# F5: named branch wt5 with exactly 1 unpushed commit, dir present and clean.
git -C "$O" worktree add --detach "$W4PATH" "$C1" >/dev/null
rm -rf -- "$W4PATH"
git -C "$O" worktree add -q -b wt5 "$W5REPO" "$C1"
printf 'wt5 work\n' > "$W5REPO/s52fx-wt5.txt"
git -C "$W5REPO" add -A
S5=$(fixture_commit "$W5REPO" 2026-10-15T09:20:00Z "S5: wt5 local commit" "$C1")
git -C "$W5REPO" update-ref HEAD "$S5"

# F9: origin/HEAD absent, exactly one origin branch ref.
git init -q -- "$F9R"
git -C "$F9R" symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/master
printf 'f9 pushed file\n' > "$F9R/s52fx-f9.txt"
git -C "$F9R" add -A
G1=$(fixture_commit "$F9R" 2026-10-15T09:30:00Z "G1: pushed")
git -C "$F9R" update-ref refs/heads/master "$G1"
git -C "$F9R" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/master "$G1"
git -C "$F9R" config remote.origin.url "$J/origins/f9.git"

# F3: kotodama-shaped repo root — 2 unpushed commits + 3 dirty tracked files.
git init -q -- "$K"
git -C "$K" symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/master
for f in k1 k2 k3 k4; do printf 'v1\n' > "$K/$f.txt"; done
git -C "$K" add -A
E0=$(fixture_commit "$K" 2026-10-15T09:40:00Z "E0: pushed baseline")
git -C "$K" update-ref refs/heads/master "$E0"
git -C "$K" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/master "$E0"
git -C "$K" symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD refs/remotes/origin/master
git -C "$K" config remote.origin.url "$J/origins/kotodama.git"
printf 'v2\n' > "$K/k1.txt"; git -C "$K" add -A
E1c=$(fixture_commit "$K" 2026-10-15T09:50:00Z "E1: local 1" "$E0")
git -C "$K" update-ref refs/heads/master "$E1c"
printf 'v2\n' > "$K/k2.txt"; git -C "$K" add -A
E2c=$(fixture_commit "$K" 2026-10-15T10:00:00Z "E2: local 2" "$E1c")
git -C "$K" update-ref refs/heads/master "$E2c"
printf 'v3\n' > "$K/k1.txt"; printf 'v3\n' > "$K/k2.txt"; printf 'v3\n' > "$K/k3.txt"

# F10 + extra secret shapes + non-secret control (plain dir, no repo).
: > "$F/envcases/prod.env"
: > "$F/envcases/.env"
: > "$F/envcases/id_rsa"
: > "$F/envcases/credentials.json"
: > "$F/envcases/server.pem"
printf 'plain control\n' > "$F/envcases/plain.txt"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ground truth
gt C1 "$C1"
gt C2 "$C2"
gt F9_G1 "$G1"
gt F1_intro "$(git -C "$O" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- s52fx-f1.txt)"
set +e; git -C "$O" merge-base --is-ancestor "$C1" refs/remotes/origin/master; r=$?; set -e
gt F1_ancestor_rc "$r"
F2_INTRO=$(git -C "$O" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- s52fx-f2-local.txt)
gt F2_intro "$F2_INTRO"
set +e; git -C "$O" merge-base --is-ancestor "$F2_INTRO" refs/remotes/origin/master; r=$?; set -e
gt F2_ancestor_rc "$r"
gt F3_unpushed_head_not_remotes "$(git -C "$K" log --oneline HEAD --not --remotes | count)"
gt F3_unpushed_branches_not_remotes "$(git -C "$K" log --oneline --branches --not --remotes | count)"
gt F3_dirty_porcelain "$(git -C "$K" status --porcelain | count)"
gt F4_unique_commits "$(git -C "$O" log --oneline "$C1" --not --all | count)"
gt F5_unpushed_branch "$(git -C "$O" log --oneline wt5 --not --remotes | count)"
gt F7_age_days "$(awk -v n="$(date +%s)" -v m="$(stat -c %Y -- "$O/.scratch/s52fx-f7-orphan.log")" 'BEGIN{printf "%d", (n-m)/86400}')"
gt F6_sha_source "$SHA_SRC"
gt F6_sha_vault "$SHA_VAULT"
set +e; git -C "$F9R" symbolic-ref --quiet --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; r=$?; set -e
gt F9_origin_head_rc "$r"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
LOG="\${GITWRAP_LOG:-/dev/null}"
args=("\$@")
i=0
cmd=""

  a="\${args[\$i]}"
  case "\$a" in

    --*=|-*) i=\$((i + 1)); continue ;;

case "\$cmd" in
  fetch|push|commit|reset|rebase|checkout)
    printf 'GITWRAP-BLOCKED: git %s\n' "\$cmd" >&2

  N=${N:-0}
  V=""; TOK=""

  elif [[ "$F3" =~ ^(SAFE|NOT-SAFE)$ ]]; then

}

judge_case() { # id sev expected_verdict token_re evidence_re args...
  local id=$1 sev=$2 expv=$3 tokre=$4 evre=$5; shift 5
  local o=$LOG/case_$id
  runenv "$o" bash "$COPIED_TOOL" "$@"
  local rc=$RC ok=1 det="" lines line
  lines=$(grep -c '^VERDICT' "$o.out" 2>/dev/null || true); lines=${lines:-0}
  if [ "$rc" != 0 ]; then ok=0; det+="rc=$rc "; fi
  if [ "$lines" != 1 ]; then ok=0; det+="verdict-lines=$lines "; fi
  line=$(grep '^VERDICT' "$o.out" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)
  parse_line "$line"
  if [ "$V" != "$expv" ]; then ok=0; det+="verdict=$V "; fi
  if ! [[ "$TOK" =~ $tokre ]]; then ok=0; det+="token=$TOK "; fi
  if [ -n "$evre" ]; then
    if ! printf '%s' "$F5" | grep -Eq -- "$evre"; then ok=0; det+="evidence-miss='$F5' "; fi
  fi
  if [ "$N" != 5 ]; then ok=0; det+="fields=$N "; fi
  if [ "$ok" = 1 ]; then det="ok rc=0 $(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -c1-220)"
  else det+="raw='$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -c1-220)'"; fi
  local lastarg="${!#}"
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$lastarg" "$V" "$TOK" "$rc" >> "$CRES"
  rec "$id" "$sev" "$ok" "$expv($tokre)${evre:+ ev:$evre}" "$det" "SHOKUNIN_ROOT=$F bash <tool-copy> $*"
}

usage_check() { # id sev want_rc args...

  local err1; err1=$(head -n 1 "$o.err" 2>/dev/null || true)
  rec "$id" "$sev" "$ok" "exit $want" "$det stderr='$(san "$err1")'" "SHOKUNIN_ROOT=$F bash <tool-copy> $*"
}

diff -u "$J/snap_before.txt" "$J/snap_after.txt" > "$J/snap_diff.txt" || true
nongit=$(awk '/^[-+][^-+]/ {line=substr($0,2); sub(/\|.*/,"",line); if (line !~ /\/\.git\//) n++} END{print n+0}' "$J/snap_diff.txt")
gitint=$(awk '/^[-+][^-+]/ {line=substr($0,2); sub(/\|.*/,"",line); if (line ~ /\/\.git\//) n++} END{print n+0}' "$J/snap_diff.txt")
ngsample=$(awk '/^[-+][^-+]/ {line=substr($0,2); sub(/\|.*/,"",line); if (line !~ /\/\.git\//) {print line; c++; if (c>=5) exit}}' "$J/snap_diff.txt")
if [ "$nongit" = 0 ]; then
  rec A_READONLY required 1 "fixture tree + vault unchanged (non-.git files)" "changed_non_git=0 git_internal_changes=$gitint" "find|sort snapshot diff x2"
else
  rec A_READONLY required 0 "fixture tree + vault unchanged (non-.git files)" "changed_non_git=$nongit sample=$(san "$ngsample")" "find|sort snapshot diff x2"
fi
meta snapshot_nongit_changes "$nongit"
meta snapshot_git_internal_changes "$gitint"

find "$J" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -printf '%f\n' | sort > "$J/top_after.txt"
diff "$J/top_before.txt" "$J/top_after.txt" > "$J/top_diff.txt" || true
strays=$(awk '/^> /{n++} END{print n+0}' "$J/top_diff.txt")
if [ "$strays" = 0 ]; then
  rec A_CWD advisory 1 "no stray files written to the judge cwd by the tool" "new_top_level=0" "ls-diff $J"
else
  rec A_CWD advisory 0 "no stray files written to the judge cwd by the tool" "new_top_level=$strays $(san "$(grep '^>' "$J/top_diff.txt" | head -n 5 || true)")" "ls-diff $J"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- tool stability
TOOL_SHA2=$(sha256sum -- "$REAL_TOOL" | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$TOOL_SHA2" = "$TOOL_SHA" ]; then
  meta tool_changed no
  rec A_STABLE advisory 1 "tools/souji-verify.sh unchanged during battery" "sha=$TOOL_SHA" "sha256sum before/after"
else
  meta tool_changed yes
  meta tool_sha256_end "$TOOL_SHA2"
  rec A_STABLE advisory 0 "tools/souji-verify.sh unchanged during battery" "before=$TOOL_SHA after=$TOOL_SHA2 (rerun on final artifact)" "sha256sum before/after"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- emit JSON
python3 "$J/mkjson.py" "$J" "$OUT_JSON" | tee "$LOG/mkjson.out"

echo "BATTERY-DONE"

# ===== mkjson.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Assemble tests/results/compliance-52.json for seat S52 (souji round 2)."""
import json
import os
import sys


def read_meta(p):
    d = {}
    for ln in open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        ln = ln.rstrip("\n")
        if "=" in ln:
            k, v = ln.split("=", 1)
            d[k] = v
    return d


def tail(p, n=8):
    try:
        lines = open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().splitlines()
    except OSError:
        return []
    return lines[-n:]


def main():
    J, out_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    checks = []
    for ln in open(os.path.join(J, "checks.tsv"), encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        parts = ln.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        if len(parts) != 6:
            continue
        checks.append(
            {
                "id": parts[0],
                "severity": parts[1],
                "pass": parts[2] == "1",
                "expected": parts[3],
                "observed": parts[4],
                "command": parts[5],
            }
        )
    meta = read_meta(os.path.join(J, "meta.env"))
    gt = read_meta(os.path.join(J, "ground_truth.tsv"))
    req_fail = [c["id"] for c in checks if c["severity"] == "required" and not c["pass"]]
    adv_fail = [c["id"] for c in checks if c["severity"] == "advisory" and not c["pass"]]
    req_total = sum(1 for c in checks if c["severity"] == "required")

    harness = ""
    for name in ("judge.sh", "mkjson.py", "xcheck.py"):
        p = os.path.join(J, name)
        harness += "# ===== %s =====\n" % name
        harness += open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read() + "\n"

    doc = {
        "seat": "S52",
        "role": "compliance-judge",
        "round": 2,
        "artifact": {
            "path": "tools/souji-verify.sh",
            "sha256": meta.get("tool_sha256"),
            "sha256_after_battery": meta.get("tool_sha256_end", meta.get("tool_sha256")),
            "lines": meta.get("tool_lines"),
            "mode": meta.get("tool_mode"),
            "executable": meta.get("tool_executable") == "yes",
            "changed_during_judging": meta.get("tool_changed") == "yes",
            "lane_head": meta.get("lane_head"),
        },
        "spec": {
            "path": "tools/souji-verify.spec.md",
            "sha256": meta.get("spec_sha256"),
        },
        "judged_at_utc": meta.get("judged_at_utc"),
        "judge": {
            "host_user": meta.get("user"),
            "git_version": meta.get("git_version"),
            "scratch_dir": J,
            "harness_sha256": meta.get("harness_sha256"),
        },
        "axes": {
            "coverage": "F1-F10 externally reproduced with own mktemp fixtures + CLI/exit-code matrix + real kotodama smoke",
            "safety": "forbidden-git wrapper (fetch/push/commit/reset/rebase/checkout), strace secret-read probe, read-only snapshot diff",
            "determinism": "combined run x2 byte-identical, single-vs-combined consistency, selftest x2",
        },
        "checks": checks,
        "summary": {
            "required_total": req_total,
            "required_passed": req_total - len(req_fail),
            "required_failed": req_fail,
            "advisory_failed": adv_fail,
            "compliant": len(req_fail) == 0,
            "safety_gates": {
                k: meta.get(k)
                for k in (
                    "wrapper_forbidden_hits",
                    "strace_f10_read_hits",
                    "strace_selftest_read_hits",
                    "snapshot_nongit_changes",
                    "tool_changed",
                )
            },
        },
        "ground_truth": gt,
        "meta": meta,
        "notable_outputs": {
            "selftest1_tail": tail(os.path.join(J, "logs", "selftest1.out")),
            "combined_lines": tail(os.path.join(J, "logs", "combined1.out"), 20),
            "kotodama_smoke": (
                tail(os.path.join(J, "logs", "smoke_kotodama.out"), 1) or [""]
            )[0],
            "lane_smoke": (
                tail(os.path.join(J, "logs", "smoke_lane.out"), 1) or [""]
            )[0],
        },
        "reproduce": {
            "notes": "mktemp dir holding raw logs + harness; extract embedded files and re-run: bash judge.sh (judge from same lane checkout). Battery is deterministic; judged sha256 is recorded above.",
            "embedded": harness,
        },
    }

    tmp = out_path + ".tmp.%d" % os.getpid()
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(doc, f, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
        f.write("\n")
    os.replace(tmp, out_path)
    print(
        "JSON-WRITTEN %s checks=%d required_failed=%s advisory_failed=%s compliant=%s"
        % (out_path, len(checks), req_fail, adv_fail, len(req_fail) == 0)
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# ===== xcheck.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cross-check combined-run output vs single-run case map (S52 judge)."""
import re
import sys


def norm(f3, f4):
    m = re.match(r"^(SAFE|NOT-SAFE)\((.*)\)$", f3)
    if m:
        return m.group(1), m.group(2)
    m2 = re.match(r"^(SAFE|NOT-SAFE)\((.*)\)$", f4)
    if m2:
        return f3, m2.group(2)
    return f3, f4


def main():
    combined_path, map_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    lines = (
        open(combined_path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().splitlines()
    )
    cmap = {}
    for ln in open(map_path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        parts = ln.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        if len(parts) < 4 or parts[0] == "A_EMPTYARG":
            continue
        cmap[parts[1]] = (parts[2], parts[3])
    problems, seen = [], {}
    for l in lines:
        if not l.startswith("VERDICT"):
            problems.append("non-VERDICT stdout line: %r" % l[:200])
            continue
        f = l.split("\t")
        if len(f) != 5:
            problems.append("not 5 fields (%d): %r" % (len(f), l[:200]))
            continue
        v, tok = norm(f[2], f[3])
        path = f[1]
        seen[path] = seen.get(path, 0) + 1
        exp = cmap.get(path)
        if exp is None:
            problems.append("unexpected target in output: %s" % path)
        elif (v, tok) != exp:
            problems.append(
                "%s: combined %s(%s) != single %s(%s)" % (path, v, tok, exp[0], exp[1])
            )
    for t in cmap:
        if t not in seen:
            problems.append("missing target in output: %s" % t)
    for p, c in seen.items():
        if c != 1:
            problems.append("target appears %dx: %s" % (c, p))
    print("XCHECK-OK" if not problems else "XCHECK-PROBLEMS")
    for p in problems:
        print(" - " + p)
    return 0 if not problems else 4


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
